parameters.snippet:
import hashlib

def hash_token(token: str) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(token.encode()).hexdigest()

# Example usage
token = "pass1"
hashed_token = hash_token(token)
print(hashed_token)  # Outputs the hashed version of the token
